provenance: Original ONSITE procedural Blender geometry, derived from the existing project prop generators. No external assets.
units: metres; Blender Z up, glTF Y up
collision: Render replacements only. Existing runtime solids and navigation are unchanged.

assets.name: CAGE_POST
assets.notes: 80 mm SHS court post, 2.72 m, on a bolted base plate. Posts sit every 2.5 m between CAGE_PANEL_2_5M modules.

assets.name: CAGE_PANEL_2_5M
assets.notes: 2.5 m wide, 2.6 m high chain-link panel (fine diagonal wire texture on a double-sided sheet) in a green 40 mm box frame. Existing footprint and gates retained.

assets.name: CAGE_GATE_4M
assets.notes: 4.0 m clear opening between 100 mm posts with a header beam; two 1.97 m leaves swung 100 degrees outward to -Y. The opening itself is walkable; collide posts and the open leaves only.

assets.name: GOAL_FIVE_A_SIDE
assets.notes: 3.66 x 1.22 m five-a-side goal, mouth faces -Y, white painted steel with a slack alpha-clipped net.

assets.name: BALL
assets.notes: Size 5 ball, 0.22 m, 32 panels with stitched seams. Dynamic prop if wanted; static it can be ignored by collision.

assets.name: CAGE_FLOODLIGHT
assets.notes: 6.5 m paired court floodlight head; replaces render mesh at existing LAMP_COLUMN positions. Existing collision remains authoritative.

assets.name: CAGE_MARKINGS
assets.notes: 30 x 20 m court, 75 mm paint lines, 5 m centre circle. Render-only; five-a-side goal offsets match the as-built fence gate clearance.
